content: Mix/Elixir docs say Mix tasks implement run/1, @requirements can run prerequisites, mix compile compiles the project and places listed deps/apps on code paths, and Code.ensure_compiled/1 may return unavailable whereas ensure_compiled!/1 is the stricter same-project module check. For Crosswake doctor, app.config/loadpaths/compile readiness should be owned by the task rather than an external pre-load.
